description:
List the built-in tool/capability manifest: each tool's id, static description, and JSON Schema for its call parameters (metadata only — no execution). Optional `mode`: omitted/'coder' = full set; 'agent' = strict general-purpose allowlist (websearch, webfetch, bash, memory, skill, actor, task, history, read, write, edit, glob, grep, question, workflow).

Free: does not call an AI provider.
name: toolManifest
